prompt: Transcribe every piece of text on this page exactly as printed, top to bottom, one printed line per output line, left to right within a line. Copy each character as it appears; do not correct, normalise or complete anything. If you cannot tell which character it is, write ? for that character. Output only the transcription. Be careful: this is a Japanese statement and the product codes mix katakana with kanji that look alike (カ/力, ロ/口, ニ/二, エ/工, ハ/八, タ/夕, and the long-vowel mark ー versus the kanji 一). Decide each one from its shape; if a shape could be either, write ?.
